outcome: A '[keyword] cost' set by an effect is only the keyword's variable cost, so the full activation cost is that amount plus the keyword's fixed cost.
A variable in a granted keyword ability is reevaluated continuously, so the value used is the one current when it is needed, not when the ability triggered.
An effect granting a listed keyword grants each variant and variable of it, such as the specific protection quality.

note: Wording equivalence with no outcome of its own.
